title: OncoGraph: Open-Source Federated Cancer Data Discovery Engine
description: OncoGraph is an open-source engine for discovering and navigating cancer research data across 30+ federated repositories. Given a cancer type and research need, it returns available datasets, endpoints, biomarkers, drug sensitivity data, imaging collections, and clinical trials from NCI CRDC, TCIA, ICGC ARGO, DepMap, GENIE, and more.
